From 87d87e6587deec1fa8ed5f5c6901535becdb0358 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Michael Niedermayer <michael@niedermayer.cc>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2021 15:22:35 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] avcodec/mpegvideo: Update chroma_?_shift in
 ff_mpv_common_frame_size_change()

Fixes: out of array access
Fixes: 31201/clusterfuzz-testcase-minimized-ffmpeg_AV_CODEC_ID_MPEG4_fuzzer-4627865612189696.fuzz

Found-by: continuous fuzzing process https://github.com/google/oss-fuzz/tree/master/projects/ffmpeg
Signed-off-by: Michael Niedermayer <michael@niedermayer.cc>
---
 libavcodec/mpegvideo.c | 7 +++++++
 1 file changed, 7 insertions(+)

diff --git a/libavcodec/mpegvideo.c b/libavcodec/mpegvideo.c
index 988dd18..728e591 100644
--- a/libavcodec/mpegvideo.c
+++ b/libavcodec/mpegvideo.c
@@ -1069,6 +1069,13 @@ int ff_mpv_common_frame_size_change(MpegEncContext *s)
         (err = av_image_check_size(s->width, s->height, 0, s->avctx)) < 0)
         return err;
 
+    /* set chroma shifts */
+    err = av_pix_fmt_get_chroma_sub_sample(s->avctx->pix_fmt,
+                                           &s->chroma_x_shift,
+                                           &s->chroma_y_shift);
+    if (err < 0)
+        return err;
+
     if ((err = init_context_frame(s)))
         return err;
 
-- 
2.55.0
